lines.text: After the uproar ended, Paul encouraged the disciples, said goodbye, and left for Macedonia.
Paul stayed three months in Greece, and when the Jews plotted against him, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
After the Feast of Tabernacles, they sailed from Philippi, and in Troas they came together on the first day of the week.
Paul spoke until midnight, and Eutychus, sitting in the window, fell asleep and dropped from the second story.
Paul embraced Eutychus and said he was alive, then spoke until daybreak, and the people took the boy home alive.
